TEDx is an international community that organizes TED-style events anywhere and everywhere -- celebrating locally-driven ideas and elevating them to a global stage. TEDx events are produced independently of TED conferences, each event curates speakers on their own, but based on TED's format and rules.

For more information on using TED for commercial purposes (e.g. employee learning, in a film or online course), please submit a Media Request here: https://media-requests.ted.com.
title: TEDx Talks

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Perimenopause might be a frustrating period. Not understanding what is happening and not feeling like yourself. This talk helps in sorting out what is what in the symptoms and empowers you to influence this part of life. It may also help in understanding the perimenopausal woman next to you. Marianne Natvik is a dedicated general practitioner, researcher and author with a profound commitment to women's health, particularly focusing on the menopause transition. She has worked for several years in hospitals with women's health and as a general practitioner in Oslo.

Her mission is to enhance care for women in midlife by fostering open conversations about this significant life stage. With a balanced approach that respects the challenges while promoting a sense of optimism, she emphasizes that this is a time where women can influence their lives, and encourages seeking help when needed. 

This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a
title: How to make sense of perimenopause (and midlife) | Marianne Natvik | TEDxArendal

author: TEDx Talks
description:
We often talk about legacy as something we leave behind, a polished outcome, a finished story. But what if legacy is formed long before the applause, shaped instead by the moments we choose honesty over protection and presence over perfection?

In this talk, Jessica Wright explores the quiet relationship between legacy and vulnerability. She challenges the cultural narrative that equates strength with emotional restraint and success with self-sacrifice. Drawing from personal insight and professional experience, she reframes vulnerability not as exposure, but as an intentional act of leadership.

This talk invites the audience to reconsider how legacy is built in real time through the risks we take to be seen, the boundaries we set, and the truth we allow ourselves to carry forward. Jessica Wright is a strategist, speaker, and philanthropic architect with over two decades of experience helping leaders and organizations turn vision into sustainable impact. Her work spans fundraising, sy
title: 1200 conversations: the practice that changed everything  | Jessica Wright | TEDxThird Ward

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In "From Invisible to Influential," Dr. Ginny Baro shares a deeply personal story about what it means to move through life and leadership while feeling unseen, even as success grows on the outside.

Drawing from her journey as an immigrant, senior corporate leader, and executive advisor, Dr. Ginny traces how a childhood instinct for safety shaped how she learned to show up, stay quiet, and wait for belonging. Through her own experience and the stories of leaders she has coached, she illustrates how invisibility can persist long after external success appears secure.

Rather than offering explanations or formulas, this talk challenges a widely held assumption: that belonging, confidence, and influence come from being recognized, chosen, or approved first. Dr. Ginny offers a different truth. Influence begins when we choose to believe in ourselves and invest in our growth before certainty arrives.

She invites audiences to notice where they may be waiting to be seen or validated and to t
title: From invisible to influential | Dr. Ginny Baro | TEDxThird Ward

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Pleasure Ain’t the Problem, Shame Is explores how shame quietly shapes our lives—training us to survive, overperform, and disconnect from our bodies, our needs, and our joy. 

Drawing from lived experience and clinical insight, Nikquan Lewis reveals how shame operates not just as a feeling, but as a pattern passed down through generations.

This talk offers a powerful reframe: pleasure is not indulgence or reward—it is a daily practice that restores regulation, connection, and freedom. By reclaiming pleasure, we interrupt cycles of burnout, self-neglect, and silence, and begin building lives that feel good, not just look good.

At its core, this talk is an invitation to stop letting shame write the story—and to take the pen back. Nikquan Lewis is a Licensed Relationship and Sex Therapist, keynote speaker, bestselling author of When Trauma Is Your Author, and Professional Wellness Consultant whose work focuses on disrupting shame and restoring connection, pleasure, and emotional safety
title: Pleasure Ain’t the Problem, Shame Is  | Nikquan Lewis | TEDxThird Ward

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this talk, Dana L. Cox explores what happens when people abandon themselves to preserve relationships, roles, and expectations. And why growth often comes with guilt.

Dana challenges the idea that loyalty requires endurance. And reframes self-love as honesty, not selfishness.

So many of us are rewarded for staying silent, staying comfortable, and staying the same. Even when it costs us. Dana invites the audience to reconsider what it means to change, to outgrow, and to choose alignment over approval.

This is a candid reflection on self-trust, self-love, and the courage it takes to stop negotiating who you are for the sake of belonging. Dana L. Cox is a leadership strategist, executive coach, speaker, and Vice President of Product Management and Development at DreamFi, where she leads high-stakes product strategy at the intersection of access, equity, compliance, and scale.

With over 30 years across financial services, technology, and consulting, Dana has held senior leadership
title: I love them all, but I love me more | Dana L. Cox | TEDxThird Ward

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Underestimation often shapes identity long before we realize it. It forms through assumptions, early fractures, and moments when others decide who we are before we do.

In this talk, Una Stevenson explores how underestimation can become an unexpected source of strength. Drawing from her own life, she introduces the G.I.F.T. framework, a way to gather what has been broken, identify hidden strengths, and transform lived experience into purpose.

This talk reframes brokenness as direction and invites us to reclaim identity, challenge assumptions, and discover the gold hidden in the places we once tried to hide. Una Stevenson is a speaker and leader shaped by lived experience, legacy, and the quiet resilience formed in life’s early complexities. Raised by her grandparents after time in foster care, she learned early that what begins as limitation can quietly become strength.

Her perspective has been forged through navigating uncertainty, carrying expectations placed on her long before sh
title: Discovering the gift of underestimation  | Una Stevenson | TEDxThird Ward

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Don’t Just Pay Taxes challenges the belief that tax is a punishment for success.
Through a deeply personal entrepreneurial story, it reframes tax as a language of alignment between individuals and society.
The talk invites leaders to move from fear and resistance to understanding and intentional design.
When we stop fighting the system and start understanding it, entirely new possibilities open up. Divakar Vijayasarathy is a global entrepreneur, tax strategist, author, and professor of tax, with over two decades of experience across 40+ countries.
As the founder of DVS Global Advisors, he lives through the same cross-border tax and regulatory challenges faced by the entrepreneurs he advises.
His philosophy, Tax as Profit, emerged from lived failures and reframes tax from a punishment into a possibility for alignment with societal priorities.
His thinking sits at the intersection of entrepreneurship, political economy, and human behavior.
Recognized as a New Champion by the World Econo
title: Reframing the meaning of taxes | Divakar Vijayasarathy | TEDxThird Ward

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Why do we stay "parked in the driveway" of our own lives? We’ve been conditioned to believe that we need a complete map before we take the first step. Drawing on her harrowing journey from post-war Vietnam to the halls of academia, and the research of expert entrepreneurs, Thanh Nguyen reveals a surprising truth: clarity is the result of action, not a prerequisite for it. This talk provides a three-step framework to overcome the "GPS-dependency" of modern life, helping you find the courage to start even when the path is invisible. Thanh Nguyen is an author, leadership coach, and Professor in the Practice at Rice University. Her bestselling books, "Unshrink Yourself: 12 Mini-Shifts to Ditch Self-Doubt and Own Your Life" and "Calm in Chaos: Mindfulness and Meditation for Busy Professionals," reflect her dual expertise in high-stakes engineering and mindfulness.

After arriving in the United States at sixteen with no money and no English, Thanh navigated a path from survival to becoming
title: Why waiting for a plan is holding you back | Thanh Nguyen | TEDxThird Ward

author: TEDx Talks
description:
A Brain Tumor Taught Me the Power of Preparation is a personal story of resilience, faith, and disciplined daily habits in the face of an unexpected diagnosis. After learning she had a benign brain tumor, Evangeline Fabia prepared for surgery by strengthening her body, sharpening her mindset, and developing the CRUMB framework, a practical approach to facing uncertainty with intention. This talk reframes preparation as an act of self-love and a powerful tool for navigating life’s most difficult moments. Evangeline Fabia is a storyteller, seafarer, and brain tumor survivor whose life spans television studios, cruise ships, and global stages. A former journalist and reality TV producer in Los Angeles, she spent over a decade casting hit shows for NBC, TLC, FOX, Food Network, and more. She also co-hosted the outdoor adventure series Let’s Go LA! before answering a calling to the sea.

For ten years, Evangeline lived and worked aboard cruise ships as a brand ambassador and future cruise s
title: A brain tumor taught me the power of preparation  | Evangeline Fabia | TEDxThird Ward

author: TEDx Talks
description: Kimberly Bady reframes menopause as a rite of passage through the lens of The Wiz and the Heroine’s Journey. Her talk invites a new understanding of midlife transition—one rooted in listening, community, and wisdom—and explores why menopause is not just a women’s issue, but a cultural one. Kimberly Bady is a speaker, author, and women’s wellness guide with over 30 years of experience creating spaces for women to explore healing, identity, and life transitions. Her work centers on reframing menopause as a rite of passage—a meaningful threshold that invites deeper listening, embodied wisdom, and coming home to oneself. Drawing from her background in holistic health coaching, yoga and breathwork, and rites-of-passage work with women and girls, Kimberly blends storytelling, cultural insight, and lived experience to challenge how society understands women’s bodies and midlife change. Through her work, she invites women—and the people who love and lead them—to see menopause not as a breakdo
title: Surviving and thriving through menopause | Kimberly Bady | TEDxThird Ward

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In a culture obsessed with productivity, performance, and hustle, burnout is often treated as inevitable. But what if burnout isn’t caused by doing too much… and instead comes from losing touch with who we are?

In this powerful TEDx talk, Pam Rivet explores the hidden cost of living from roles instead of identity and reveals why awareness, not crisis, is the true catalyst for transformation. Through a deeply personal story and research-backed insight, she unpacks how stacking roles like parent, professional, caregiver, and achiever can quietly disconnect us from ourselves long before life falls apart.

Drawing on concepts from identity psychology and what she calls living beyond the cape, Pam introduces a new way of thinking about burnout, purpose, and self awareness. She explains how role based identity conflict drains our emotional energy, clouds clarity, and leaves us surviving instead of fully inhabiting our lives.

This talk invites you to stop waiting for rock bottom to wake yo
title: How To Prevent Burnout (And No, It’s Not Balance) | Pam Rivet | TEDxThird Ward

author: TEDx Talks
description: Music has been an essential part of the human experience for thousands of years, helping us interpret, understand and even shape the world around us. Music’s unique qualities have been especially potent when helping us process complicated subjects like love, war, death and religion. But what about one of the biggest challenges that has emerged during the last 50 years? In the face of climate change does music continue its traditional functions? This performance will tackle different approaches to climate change music and unravel the nature of music, the nature of humanity and the nature of climate change.  Paul Suchan is a composer, performer, educator and alumnus of the University of Saskatchewan (USask), graduating with a Bachelor of Music/Bachelor of Music Education in 2007. He received a Master of Music in composition in 2012 from the Université de Montréal where he studied with composer Alan Belkin. He lives in Saskatoon with his wife Naomi, daughter Evelyn and son Isaac. His bod
title: In a changing climate, where is all of the music? | Paul Suchan | TEDxUniversityofSaskatchewan

author: TEDx Talks
description:
La propuesta de Juan Retali pone el foco en un cambio clave del mundo comercial actual: ya no alcanza con vender productos, hoy las marcas necesitan generar experiencias que conecten emocionalmente con sus clientes.

En un contexto donde el consumo se transforma constantemente, la tecnología avanza y la competencia crece, el comercio minorista enfrenta el desafío de reinventarse. Retali plantea que el verdadero diferencial está en entender el recorrido del cliente, escuchar sus necesidades y construir una relación basada en la cercanía, la personalización y la experiencia. Consultor | Escritor del libro "Tiendas que Enamoran" This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: El Poder de la Cercanía  | Juan Retali | TEDxMaipú

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Giuseppe è il Presidente di Space Eagle. Nel suo ruolo, guida l'azienda verso nuove frontiere nel campo dell'esplorazione spaziale. Con una profonda passione per l'innovazione tecnologica, Giuseppe lavora per rendere lo spazio più accessibile e sostenibile., mantenendo il contatto con il territorio del Sud Italia. Il suo approccio unisce visione imprenditoriale e rigore scientifico per affrontare le sfide del futuro.

Si può fondare una realtà aerospaziale partendo da una chat di gruppo, a 16 anni, in pigiama? Giuseppe Mondilla e il team di Space Eagle dimostrano che l'innovazione non chiede il permesso e non aspetta la laurea. Un viaggio incredibile dalla cameretta alle basi di lancio internazionali in Texas e Portogallo, che svela il potere della Peer Education. Guardate questo talk per capire perché non serve essere ingegneri perfetti  per iniziare, ma serve iniziare per diventare ingegneri perfetti.

Visit our website: https://www.tedxgiarre.com/ - Follow us on LinkedIn: https://w
title: Space Eagle: da una chat di WhatsApp allo Spazio | Giuseppe Mondilla | TEDxGiarre

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Giarre è spesso raccontata come la capitale delle incompiute. Ma cosa succede quando trasformi quella sensazione di "mancanza" in un motore per conquistare il mondo? Maria Carla Sapuppo ci porta dal profumo di mandorla di una pasticceria di provincia fino a Milano, passando per la Biennale di Venezia, dove trova un pezzo (controverso) della sua Giarre, svelando come l'identità locale e la "manutenzione dei sogni" siano le vere competenze del futuro. Scopri perché restare provinciali è la nuova avanguardia e come la testardaggine può diventare la tua risorsa più preziosa.

Maria Carla Sapuppo è una digital strategist, consulente e formatrice con oltre dieci anni di esperienza nel branding e nella comunicazione integrata. Dopo un percorso consolidato tra agenzie e consulenza aziendale, oggi guida imprese e professionisti nella costruzione di presenze digitali autentiche, curando strategie di content marketing, social media e personal branding. Docente di Digital Communication per divers
title: Da Giarre con amore (e testardaggine) | Maria Carla Sapuppo | TEDxGiarre

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Artificial Intelligence is no longer a distant possibility — it is our present reality.

In this insightful talk, Prof. Amod Bhat explores how AI is transforming the way we live, work and think. From emerging trends to groundbreaking innovations, he unpacks how rapidly this technology is evolving — and why the future will be deeply intertwined with AI.

But this isn’t just about machines or algorithms. It’s about adaptation, responsibility and the choices we make as a society. As AI reshapes industries, education and everyday life, the real question becomes: Are we ready for the future we are creating?

This talk offers clarity, perspective and a forward-looking vision of a world where intelligence — both artificial and human — must coexist and collaborate. Prof. Amod Bhat is an Educator, Author and Global advocate for International Education and Artificial Intelligence, working at the intersection of Learning, Technology and Human potential. With advanced academic exposure from insti
title: AI's impact is reshaping our world | Amod Bhat | TEDxAUCE

author: TEDx Talks
description:
What truly sets successful people apart?

In this inspiring talk, Commodore Atul Kumar Rastogi reminds us that the difference lies in two powerful choices: the books we read and the people we surround ourselves with. The ideas we consume shape our thinking. The company we keep shapes our character. If chosen wisely, both can elevate our path.

But life is not easy — and it was never meant to be. Through powerful reflections, he shares a timeless truth:
If you know your enemy, you may win a battle.
But if you know yourself, you can win a hundred.

This talk is a call to be intentional — about learning, about influence and most importantly about self-awareness. Because lasting success begins from within. Commodore Atul Kumar Rastogi brings a lifetime shaped by maritime command, strategic education and nation-building leadership, reflecting how disciplined service and human development intersect to create enduring impact. On the TEDx stage, Commodore Rastogi offers insights forged throug
title: You Too Can Be A Success | Atul Kumar Rastogi | TEDxAUCE

author: TEDx Talks
description: This talk explores how sporting success can transform a community, showing how culture, environment, discipline, and small everyday actions can compound into extraordinary achievement. Jackson is a dedicated sports enthusiast whose talk explores how discipline, mindset, and a strong environment can fuel success. Drawing on examples from elite sport, he shows how small actions can build momentum and inspire communities. His message highlights that success isn’t accidental — it’s built step by step. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: THE RIPPLE EFFECT OF SUCCESS IN SPORT | Jackson . | TEDxMethodist College Belfast Youth

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Insecurity thrives where ignorance persists. Sony Otache makes a compelling case that classrooms are stronger than weapons. By investing in education, formal, informal, and vocational, Nigeria can break cycles of violence, unemployment, and extremism. This talk presents education not just as learning, but as national security strategy. Sony Otache is a renowned media personality, entrepreneur, and multimedia expert with over three decades of experience spanning broadcasting, production, media consulting, and community development across the West African sub-region.

Widely respected for his voice, vision, and versatility. He has built a career defined by impact, credibility, and innovation. A seasoned broadcaster, Chief Otache ow the host of the widely followed Oga Landlord Radio Show and Crusaders Radio This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Education as the Antidote to Insecurity in Nigeria | Sony Otache | TEDxMinna

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Is poverty truly about lack of resources or lack of access? 
Aishah dismantles the long-held belief that Northern Nigeria is inherently poor. She argues that the real crisis is systemic disconnection: from infrastructure, technology, opportunity, and investment. This talk reframes the narrative and proposes strategic reconnection as the pathway to prosperity. Aishah N. Ahmad, CFA, OFR, is a global finance and policy leader whose work sits at the intersection of financial systems, gender equity, and societal transformation. With nearly 30 years of experience, she curates the Bridgforte Dialogues at UNGA, is Chair of the Graça Machel Trust Expert Leaders’ Group (ELG), and holds the traditional title of Soniya Asusu Nupe—a stewardship role committed to enterprise, community prosperity, and cultural legacy. She was Deputy Governor for Financial System Stability at the Central Bank of Nigeria (2018–2023), where she oversaw landmark reforms in digital finance, financial inclusion, and banki
title: The North is Not Poor. The North is Disconnected. | Aishah N. Ahmad, CFA, OFR | TEDxMinna

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Sustainability is no longer a choice — it is a responsibility.

In this compelling talk, Prof. S. Ramakrishna speaks about the urgent need for environmental sustainability and the role each of us must play in shaping a greener future. As climate challenges intensify and natural resources decline, he reminds us that awareness alone is not enough — action is essential.

This talk is a call to take a stand. To move beyond convenience. To rethink consumption, innovation, and accountability — not just as individuals, but as communities and institutions.

Because the future of our planet is not decided tomorrow.
It is decided by the choices we make today. Prof. S. Ramakrishna Rao has spent decades at the vital intersection of Development and Environmental Responsibility, shaping how infrastructure growth and ecological stewardship can progress together.  His work has informed some of the Nation’s most consequential Environmental Decisions. With deep expertise in Environmental Assessment, Re
title: Wake up to conserve environment | S Ramakrishna Rao | TEDxAUCE

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Behind every well-run home is work we rarely see — and rarely value.

In this powerful talk, Sameera Maruvada brings us the story of Pranathi, a woman who runs her household so effortlessly that her labor becomes invisible. Done quietly, out of love, her contribution is assumed to be duty — not work.

But this story asks a larger question:
Why do we only value what earns money?
And when did care become an obligation instead of a contribution?

This talk challenges us to rethink respect, recognition and the true meaning of worth — beginning at home. Sameera Maruvada is a Visual Storyteller, Creative Director, and Entrepreneur who believes creativity is most powerful when it serves a purpose. Through her work with brands, institutions and her homegrown platform "Saltandsambar", she transforms complex ideas into compelling visual narratives that spark empathy, dialogue and change. Deeply rooted in Visakhapatnam yet globally minded, Sameera weaves art with advocacy—using design, illustrat
title: Just tell me what to do | Sameera Maruvada | TEDxAUCE

author: TEDx Talks
description:
As ambition increasingly takes new forms, we’re left asking an important question: should we follow the safety of conventional careers, or choose paths driven by passion and purpose? In today’s evolving world, success is no longer limited to engineering, medicine, or law—careers in creative, digital, and public-facing domains are reshaping how we define achievement. This talk explores the reality of pivoting away from stability to pursue what truly matters, examining both the freedom and the pressures that come with unconventional choices. Dil v/s Duniya? Invites us to look beyond societal expectations and reflect on what it truly means to build a fulfilling career. Ameya is a storyteller and content creator. He began as a child actor in the famous Marathi television serial De Dhamal. He later studied Applied Art and photography, graduating as a gold medallist and a CAG award winner.
While still in college, driven by curiosity to understand how reality television works, he applied for
title: Dil v/s Duniya | Amey Kadam | TEDxMMCOE

author: TEDx Talks
description: In this TEDx Talk, Toia challenges the notion that parental rights can be terminated by the State and invites the audience to see motherhood as something that can never be erased.  Toia Potts is a mother and fierce activist in North Carolina. She is the Co-founder of Carolina Parent Defenders, the Founder of Thrive Tribe NC, Family Advocate/Organizer for EmancipateNC and she serves as a Community Griot with the Ujima Collective. Toia’s path into advocacy started when her family was pulled apart by Child Protective Services. She now uses her voice to create change for parents, mostly mothers, who are navigating the system. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/tedx
title: Motherhood Cannot Be Erased By The State | Toia Potts | TEDxLake Alfred

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Climate action is not only about saving the planet, it is about saving people. Dr. Dooba reveals how renewable energy, sustainable agriculture, and green innovation can lift communities out of poverty. By aligning environmental responsibility with economic empowerment, he presents climate action as a practical tool for inclusive development. ibraheem dooba is a multidisciplinary scholar whose career spans five sectors: computing, journalism, education, agriculture, and finance. 

His academic journey spans four continents, earning six degrees from world-class institutions, including Harvard University (Multiple Intelligences postgraduate program), Stanford University (Advanced Cybersecurity), and the London School of Journalism (Honours Diploma in Media Law). 

He holds a PhD in Information Technology from PETRONAS University of Technology, Malaysia’s top private university.

Dr. Dooba has served as Chief Press Secretary to a state governor, Chief Data Scientist at RBA, and an Editori
title: Using Climate Action to End Poverty | DR Ibraheem Dooba | TEDxMinna

True success is measured not by applause today, but by impact tomorrow. Saadiya explores what it means to build institutions, values, and systems that endure beyond one’s lifetime. This talk challenges leaders, entrepreneurs, and changemakers to think long-term and design legacies rooted in purpose, service, and sustainability. Saadiya Aliyu is the Managing Director/CEO Urban Shelter Ltd .

Saadiya is an executive management professional, who is results-oriented.  She is focused, driven and dynamic with over 15 years of progressive leadership experience. author: TEDx Talks
description:
Beyond headlines and assumptions lies a deeper story of the Almajiri system. Sheikh Lemu explores its historical roots, present realities, and future possibilities. With vision and data-driven optimism, he presents transformative pathways that can convert vulnerability into value, charting a hopeful roadmap toward 2050. Sheikh Nuruddeen Lemu is the Director of Research and Training at the Da’wah Institute of Nigeria (DIN), Islamic Education Trust (IET) in Minna, Nigeria. He develops, facilitates and conducts train-the-trainers courses in enhancing inter-faith dialogue and engagement, intra-faith cooperation, building resilience against various forms of religious extremism among Muslims, and promoting faith-based critical thinking tools for Muslims (“Shari’ah Intelligence”). 
He is on the board of several organizations including: Lotus Capital (Halal Investments) Limited, Lotus Bank Ltd., the Development Initiative of West Africa (DIWA), the Almajiri Child Rights Initiative (ACRI), ICI
title: Almajiri Untold: Pathways from Poverty to Promise by 2050 | Muhammad Nurudeen Lemu OON | TEDxMinna

author: TEDx Talks
description:
In this talk, Daniel reflects on how evolving technology is reshaping human values and weakening our sense of connection. Drawing on childhood memories and his experiences living in Uganda, he highlights the importance of cultural values in fostering meaningful relationships. He offers insights on how to rediscover connection in an increasingly disconnected world. Daniel was born in the University town of Cambridge, in the United Kingdom, and grew up in the Cambridgeshire countryside. His mother is a retired school teacher and his father a retired gardener at a historic property.   Daniel moved to Uganda in 2003 to teach internationally, and is married to Alice and they have four sons who attend the International School of Uganda.

Daniel, now the Head of School, at the International School of Uganda, has taken on many roles at the school, including Junior School Principal, Director of Technology, Director of Admissions, PYP and MYP Coordinator and College Counseling.  This eclectic e
title: Disconnected by connection | Daniel Todd | TEDxIntl School Of Uganda

author: TEDx Talks
description:
Judah Mkhambi and Chloé Swanepoel dance to the Shift Theme Judah Mkambi and Chloé Swanepoel are young South African dancers whose work blends technical excellence with powerful storytelling. Emerging from the Garden Route and shaped by the Rhythmical Seeds collective, they have performed on both national and international stages, using movement as a language of purpose, emotion, and connection.

Together, their artistry reflects a new generation of performers redefining dance as more than entertainment; it becomes a tool for healing, expression, and cultural shift. Judah brings discipline and vision rooted in impact, while Chloé’s performances carry strength, sensitivity, and authenticity.

Their work demonstrates how young voices, grounded in creativity and purpose, can inspire, challenge, and move audiences, proving that dance has the power to tell stories that truly matter. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local co
title: Shift Dance | Judah Mkhambi and Chloé Swanepoel  | TEDxGeorge
